confidence_notes: The meal, coffee and beer estimates use [Numbeo's crowdsourced Suzhou prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Suzhou); July-specific prices are uncertain. Cocktail and wine estimates allow for a premium over domestic beer, informed by prices at [two local bars](https://www.suzhouscene.com/venues/jennys-bar) and [another venue](https://suzhouscene.com/venues/blue-marlin2). Accommodation prices are holistic estimates and may vary substantially with summer demand and availability.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use the broader Jiangnan urban tourism market, including Hangzhou and Nanjing, with Suzhou generally less expensive than Shanghai.
